keyLimits.en: 10 corporate cards, 10 user seats (8 employee + 2 admin/accountant), up to 15 invoices/month, up to 15 reimbursements/month, single entity only, basic ERP integrations, no Procure-to-Pay or multi-entity management

Modular pricing: choose core modules (Travel, Cards & Expenses, Bill Pay, Procure to Pay), unit-based scaling for cards/reimbursements/invoices, and optional add-ons for advanced ERP/HRIS integrations, multi-entity, budget tracking, credit line; typically annual or multi-year contracts, no flat setup fee

cautions.en: The entry-level Growth Program is capped at a single legal entity and excludes Procure-to-Pay and multi-entity management, which require the custom Enterprise plan.
Enterprise pricing is fully custom and modular; no fixed price list is published beyond the Growth Program.

capabilities.en: All-in-one spend management: corporate cards, expense management, bill pay/invoices, and reimbursements in one platform.
AI-native automated data extraction for expenses and invoices.

limitations.en: Growth Program plan supports a single legal entity only; multi-entity management requires the custom Enterprise tier.
Procure-to-Pay functionality is not available on the Growth Program plan.

reason.en: Direct competitor for spend management, cards and expense automation.
Competing expense and corporate card management platform.
Overlapping business banking and expense management features for the same buyer.

unknowns: Full Enterprise-tier pricing is not published; figures depend on module selection and negotiated contract.
Whether VAT/tax is included in the £149/month Growth Program price is not stated.
